# ARC200 vacuum arc melter

[*Arcast, Inc, Oxford, ME, USA*](https://www.arcast.com/)

::: {.callout-note}
Vacuum arc melting
: the use of an electric arc between a thoriated tungsten electrode and a water-cooled copper crucible to melt conductive materials in a vacuum environment, producing high quality ingots with low contamination and controlled composition.
:::

![](/files/photos/Capabilities/MME-Critical Alloy Research and Discovery Lab-Payton-22.jpg){img-alt="Students using vacuum arc melter and gas atomization equipment in the CARD Lab at the University of Cincinnati"}

Accessories:

* continuous material feeding unit
* tilt-pour casting
* 800A power supply
* turbo-pump
* electromagnetic stirring
* free-fall gas atomization unit
